f3_program: observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "December 28, 2018"), -7, "million_currency", cell("Amount recognized in other comprehensive (loss) income", "December 28, 2018"))

observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "December 29, 2017"), 10, "million_currency", cell("Amount recognized in other comprehensive (loss) income", "December 29, 2017"))

query("difference", at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "December 29, 2017"), at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "December 28, 2018"))
collection("owen.turtles", "turtle", "owen", source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
collection("johanna.turtles", "turtle", "johanna", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
observe(at("owen.turtles.count", "initial"), 21, "count", source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
offset(at("johanna.turtles.count", "initial"), at("owen.turtles.count", "initial"), -5, "count", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
multiple(at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), at("owen.turtles.count", "initial"), 2, source("After 1 month, Owen has twice as many turtles as before"))
remove("johanna_loses_half", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), fraction(at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("Johanna loses half of her turtles"))
transfer("johanna_donates_rest", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), source("donates the rest to Owen"))
query("value", at("owen.turtles.count", "current"))
collection("james.cattle", "cattle", "james", source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle"))
add("james_buys_cattle", "james", at("james.cattle.count", "current"), 100, source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle"))
observe(at("james.cattle.purchase_cost.total", "purchase"), 40000, "dollar", source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle for $40,000"))
percent_more(at("james.cattle.feeding_cost.total", "feeding"), at("james.cattle.purchase_cost.total", "purchase"), 20, source("It cost 20% more than that to feed them"))
observe(at("james.cattle.member.weight", "sale"), 1000, "pound", source("They each weigh 1000 pounds"))
observe(at("james.cattle.sale_price.rate", "sale"), 2, "dollar_per_pound", source("sell for $2 per pound"))
product_relation(at("james.cattle.weight.total", "sale"), event_field("james_buys_cattle", "quantity"), at("james.cattle.member.weight", "sale"), source("They each weigh 1000 pounds"))
product_relation(at("james.cattle.sale_revenue.total", "sale"), at("james.cattle.weight.total", "sale"), at("james.cattle.sale_price.rate", "sale"), source("sell for $2 per pound"))

sum_relation(at("james.cattle.cost.total", "sale"), at("james.cattle.purchase_cost.total", "purchase"), at("james.cattle.feeding_cost.total", "feeding"), source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle for $40,000.  It cost 20% more than that to feed them"))
query("difference", at("james.cattle.cost.total", "sale"), at("james.cattle.sale_revenue.total", "sale"))
